swap-guard.goal: Make every enemy get hit, without being hit yourself.
swap-guard.how-to-play.step-1: Shaded squares show where each enemy will strike.
swap-guard.how-to-play.step-2: Tap a square next to you to swap places with what stands there.
swap-guard.how-to-play.step-3: Then every strike lands. Anyone on a shaded square is hit.
swap-guard.how-to-play.step-4: Swap enemies into strikes, and never stop on one yourself.
swap-guard.name: Swap Guard
swap-guard.tagline: Swap places. Let them hit each other.
swap-guard.tutorial.step-1: A strike is coming for you. Tap the enemy next to you to swap!
swap-guard.tutorial.step-2: They hit each other! Now step behind the last enemy.
swap-guard.tutorial.step-3: Swap with it. Now its strike points at you.
swap-guard.tutorial.step-4: Swap back: it walks into its own strike!
